stops.title: Di Lis dɛn
stops.caption: Fɔs-tɛm, nɔ grup, ɛn let.
stops.speech: Fɔlo ɔp gɛt tri lis: fɔs-tɛm pipul we nɔbɔdi nɔ tɔk to yet, pipul we nɔ de na ɛni grup, ɛn kɔntakt dɛn we dɔn let.

stops.title: Rɛkɔd Wan
stops.caption: Udat, aw, ɛn wetin nɛks.
stops.speech: Fɔ rɛkɔd fɔlo ɔp de kip udat tɔk to am, aw, wetin apin, ɛn wetin fɔ apin nɛks. Dɛn kin mak am as wɔri bak.
